entities.summary: Paolo Sylos Labini was an Italian economist and political advisor in post-World War II Italy. He was a professor at the Sapienza University of Rome and member of the Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei. His theoretical contributions covered oligopoly, the relation between innovation and market structure, inflation, and socioeconomic evolution. His work often contained a strong historical dimension, in common with Classical economics.
